svg.title: PegaInfer architecture
svg.desc: OpenAI clients connect to a Rust frontend and engine contract. Seven model-owned engines share GPU primitives, sampling, kernel integration, and model-specific KV infrastructure. Native compute and communication libraries execute GPU work; PegaFlow and kvbm-logical support the KV data plane. This is an ownership overview, not a complete dependency graph.
svg.text: pegainfer-server selects and launches the model
Scheduling · state · kernel plans · parallel execution
Ownership overview · component adoption and capabilities vary by model.
